mapper.select: SELECT current.template_id AS templateId, current.version_no AS versionNo, current.channel_name AS channelName, current.content_text AS contentText, current.required_variables AS requiredVariables, current.state_name AS stateName, current.created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_template_version current WHERE current.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current.version_no = ( SELECT MAX(latest.version_no) FROM mk_template_version latest WHERE latest.tenant_id = current.tenant_id AND latest.template_id = current.template_id ) ORDER BY current.template_id

SELECT effect_type AS effectType, enrollment_id AS enrollmentId, payload_hash AS payloadHash, state_name AS stateName, contact_id AS contactId, provider_code AS providerCode FROM mk_engagement_command WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND command_id = #{commandId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT template_id AS templateId, version_no AS versionNo, channel_name AS channelName, content_text AS contentText, required_variables AS requiredVariables, state_name AS stateName, created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_template_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}

SELECT contact_id AS contactId, contact_key AS contactKey, state_name AS stateName, provider_request_id AS providerRequestId, provider_code AS providerCode, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mk_contact_attempt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contact_key = #{contactKey}

SELECT contact_id AS contactId, contact_key AS contactKey, state_name AS stateName, provider_request_id AS providerRequestId, provider_code AS providerCode, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mk_contact_attempt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contact_id = #{contactId}

SELECT contact_id AS contactId, contact_key AS contactKey, state_name AS stateName, provider_request_id AS providerRequestId, provider_code AS providerCode, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mk_contact_attempt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND provider_request_id = #{providerRequestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT candidate.tenant_id AS tenantId, candidate.event_id AS eventId, candidate.destination_topic AS destinationTopic, candidate.partition_key AS partitionKey, candidate.payload_json AS payloadJson, candidate.publish_attempts AS publishAttempts FROM mk_engagement_outbox candidate WHERE candidate.published_at IS NULL AND candidate.dead_lettered_at IS NULL AND candidate.next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mk_engagement_outbox predecessor WHERE predecessor.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND predecessor.contact_id = candidate.contact_id AND predecessor.published_at IS NULL AND predecessor.dead_lettered_at IS NULL AND predecessor.stream_sequence < candidate.stream_sequence ) ORDER BY candidate.created_at, candidate.stream_sequence LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_engagement_outbox SET published_at = #{stateAt}, publish_attempts = #{publishAttempts}, last_error = '' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL
